facts.fact: OONI measurements show ISPs in Mozambique blocked Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp from 29 October to 14 November 2024 amid post-election protests, after the communications institute (INCM) announced internet restrictions.

Human Rights Watch reports mobile and internet access was restricted from 25 October 2024 after post-election protests, with social media blocked, and operators confirmed restoration on 18 November 2024.
